title: A new case is classified with an intent and a priority
risk: An inbound request is never classified, so it stays invisible to the queue and breaches first-response commitments silently.
preconditions: Tenant T1 with a conversation for cust-a carrying the utterance 'my order has not arrived' in namespace cd-case-*
Case created at 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z with priority P3 default

steps.action: Create the case from the inbound utterance and read its initial projection
steps.expected: state is NEW, priority P3, and the case is linked to the conversation and to cust-a

steps.action: Apply the classification transition with intent shipping and priority P2
steps.expected: the case reports state CLASSIFIED, intent shipping, priority P2 and a state-change timestamp after creation

steps.action: Read the audit trail for the case
steps.expected: exactly one NEW to CLASSIFIED entry exists with the actor, the previous state and the new state
the case stays CLASSIFIED and the audit gains no second transition for that event identity

assertions: The case projection reports CLASSIFIED with intent shipping and priority P2
Exactly one audit entry records the NEW to CLASSIFIED transition
The duplicate classification produces zero additional transitions and does not regress the state
forbidden: Accept a classification with an intent outside the ten supported intents
Skip NEW and write a case directly in CLASSIFIED with no audit entry
evidence: Case projection before and after classification (state, intent, priority, timestamps)
Audit entries for the case with actor and previous/new state
cleanup: Delete the run-scoped case and its conversation link for cd-case-*; keep the append-only audit entries
automation: Drive the real case-management skill against fixture conversations, freezing the clock so ordering is deterministic; state the oracle on the projection and the audit count, not on the enum definition.
note: Generated acceptance specification. Plain specification, not an executable test; no application runtime exists, so the status is NOT_RUN.
